# BR Publications

> BR Publications is an academic publisher (registered under the Ministry of MSME, Government of India) of scholarly books and peer-reviewed book chapters. Each chapter page carries its abstract, authors with affiliations, DOI, ISBN and a PDF.

## Catalogue
- [Books](https://www.brpublications.com/books): authored books and monographs
- [Book chapters](https://www.brpublications.com/bookchapters): edited volumes; each chapter has its own page at /book/{id}/chapter-{n}/{title}
- [ResNova](https://www.brpublications.com/resnova): book chapter publishing programme

## About
- [About us](https://www.brpublications.com/about)

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://www.brpublications.com/sitemap.xml)

## Citation
Cite chapters using the DOI shown on each chapter page (doi.org/10.65470/...). Chapter pages expose Google Scholar citation_* meta tags and schema.org ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD.
